description: Tang Nano 9K FPGA Development Board based on Gowin GW1NR-9 with 8640 LUT4, 64M SDR SDRAM, 32Mbit SPI Flash, 608K User Flash, HDMI + RGB + SPI screen interfaces, USB-JTAG/UART via BL702, 2 buttons, 6 LEDs, TF slot, 48P headers. Ideal for FPGA learning and RISC-V PicoRV softcore verification.

specs.Display: HDMI interface, SPI screen interface, RGB screen interface
specs.Debugger: Onboard BL702 chip provides USB-JTAG and USB-UART
specs.IO Features: 4mA/8mA/16mA/24mA drive, Bus Keeper, pull-up/pull-down, Open Drain per I/O
